Description: Log in with valid username and password
Expected Result: User is redirected to the dashboard and a welcome message is displayed.

Description: Log in with an incorrect password
Expected Result: Login fails and an error message 'Invalid username or password' is shown.

Description: Log in with an empty username field
Expected Result: Login is blocked and a validation message 'Username is required' is shown.

Description: Log in with an empty password field
Expected Result: Login is blocked and a validation message 'Password is required' is shown.

Description: Log in with a locked account after multiple failed attempts
Expected Result: Login is denied and an error message 'Account is locked. Try again later.' is shown.

Description: Request password reset with a valid registered email address
Expected Result: A confirmation message is shown and a password reset link is sent to the email.

Description: Request password reset with an unregistered email address
Expected Result: A generic confirmation message is shown without revealing whether the email exists.

Description: Request password reset with an empty email field
Expected Result: Request is blocked and a validation message 'Email is required' is shown.

Description: Request password reset with an invalid email format
Expected Result: Request is blocked and a validation message 'Enter a valid email address' is shown.

Description: Reset password using an expired reset link
Expected Result: Reset fails and an error message 'This reset link has expired' is shown.
